description: scimt.train._grep_checkpoint is private and copy-pasted in >=6 experiments; trainable-state (not sampler) path isn't surfaced at all (midtrain3_aff hand-rolls ckpt_path_state). title: checkpoint bookkeeping public: export tinker:// pointer grep + state_path in train() manifest
